scope: Deterministic per-session reporting over the frozen configured instrument set and strategy-emitted candidates.
implemented: Each finalized session report includes its exchange date denominator, planned/quoted/missing instrument counts, and quote-event count.
Strategy candidate count and quote coverage are reported; actionable BUY/SELL decisions count as one candidate when no candidate list is emitted.
Execution receipts contribute accepted/rejected quote counts, filled quote count, missed candidate count, and a lost-opportunity denominator.
Candidate notional is reported only when explicitly supplied; unavailable notional and quote-receipt denominators are identified rather than imputed.
Reports explicitly label the denominator universe as strategy output, not market-wide opportunity discovery.

tests.result: 27 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed for session_runner.py.

limitations: Coverage is limited to configured instruments and strategy-emitted candidates; it is not a market-wide scanner denominator.
Candidate notional must be emitted by the strategy; no notional is inferred from absent price/quantity fields.
Fixtures establish report behavior only; no prospective Kite quote coverage or real missed-opportunity rates are claimed.
